activity_summary: At rehearsal the line broke once on sceptred and held the second time. Richard had the glass face up on the throne and would not say why, and you did not ask. He takes it off only when he must sit. Nick stood by the door. The gown is the one he has. Garnish left the Master's cut as it is: the king goes off a king and comes on a prisoner, and the unmaking is reported. You are not writing that scene back.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Broke on one word, said the line again, and did not ask about the glass.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Kept the glass on the seat, and sent him home to count silver.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Hung the plot, and refused to restore the cut.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Would rather hear the word than a story about the word.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Stood by the door, and was told the gown is the one he has.

facets.activity: Broke once on sceptred and held the line the second time

quotes.text: This royall throne of Kings, this sceptred Ile,
